reason: Under the value and transfer lens the gain is real in sign but about 10x too small, and it can never be seen on the LB. (1) Coverage: 1,337 readmitted of 121,777 raw nodes on 4 dummy clips = 1.1% (CONTEXT.md 2026-09-25 08:40). Gap-filled nodes are capped at 3% (DIFF.md l.71: GAPFILL_MAX_ADDED_FRAC 0.03), and the real count is not in the repo (guess <1%). (2) Output channel: the head only removes grid quantisation (mean shift 0.74 um, max 1.61 um, only 10.5% move >= 1 um; research/wf_ideas_v2/r1_research_gate-aware-refine-head.json). x138 already runs linefit with weight 0.8 and window 2, which pulls every interior node 80% onto a local line fit, so most of the grid noise on readmitted or gap-filled nodes inside tracks is already diluted. The closest direct datum is float output coordinates on ALL nodes: lab +0.0017 (CI90 +0.0008..+0.0025), public LB a TIE twice (#32 0.950 = #31 0.950; #33 0.948 = exp48 0.948; CONTEXT 07:50). This idea covers 2-4% of the nodes, so its output-channel effect is ~0.0017*0.03*0.5 = ~3e-5. (3) Decision channel (the only real mechanism): 0.74 um shifts flip a few decisions at the 4 um readmit radius, the 2 um exclusion and the 3.5 um gap-fill peak radius, roughly symmetrically. The anchors are already refined, so the refined candidate is only slightly less noisy. Readmitted nodes get relinked with edge_prob 0.0 (CONTEXT 08:15), so only the relink geometry changes. Pro rata of the head's +0.007 on x138: ~2.2% of edges touch readmitted nodes, giving 0.00015, or ~0.0005 with a guessed 3x break-point weight. That +0.007 is itself one LB difference (0.946 -> 0.953) under LB noise 0.003, and on our base the head gave only +0.002, so the realistic value is +0.0001..+0.0004. (4) Node multiplier: node count changes by tens out of ~121k, which is < 1e-5. (5) Transfer: nothing here leans on network confidence and there are no 44b6-crop or embryo-offset artefacts beyond those the head already carries on 97% of nodes, so public and private gains are about equal. They are equally invisible: expected +0.0002 against the 0.001 display step and 0.003 noise. P(public >= +0.002) is < 5% (guess). It fails the +0.002 bar. Practical caveats if built anyway: _lsc must be gathered at the integer _low indices BEFORE refining. The refine call must not double-count the COORDHEAD stats or anchor on the V1284 coord_offset line (the x122 anchor-collision failure mode). The low pool at threshold 0.5 is several times larger than the main pool (small extra head cost).
fix_if_any: It cannot be made worth +0.002. The best use is as a free, zero-risk consistency rider inside a bundle that is scored anyway (e.g. whatever x138-based build goes out on 26 Sep), under knob BIOHUB_LOWDET_REFINE=1. Gate it on dummy checks only: knob=0 byte-identical to exp56; knob=1 readmitted and gap-filled counts within +-10% per clip; no REPAIR FAILED; the score for each low peak is gathered from the integer grid before refinement; float32 kept in the dump. Never spend its own LB slot on it and never attribute a bundle's LB delta to it. If the team wants the mechanism to matter, the lever is the 4 um READMIT_RADIUS / 3.5 um GAPFILL_PEAK_RADIUS geometry itself, and relink knobs are a CLOSED line.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0002 (range 0 .. +0.0005); below the 0.001 display step and the 0.003 LB noise; P(>= +0.002) < 5% (guess)
realistic_private_gain: +0.0002 (range -0.0002 .. +0.0005); transfers as well as public because it relies on no confidence, but the gain is equally negligible
critical_path: Technically feasible, but not worth a slot. 26 Sep ~01:00-02:00 UTC: agent-container patches the exp56 cell-4 'lowdet peaks' / 'lowdet write' replacements behind BIOHUB_LOWDET_REFINE and runs the byte-identity test with the knob at 0 (1 h). 26 Sep ~02:00-03:00 UTC: Vitalii runs a private dummy run on Kaggle vitaliineibauer after the 00:00 GPU reset (~0.7 GPU-h). 26 Sep ~03:30 UTC: it is submitted only as a rider in an already approved x138-based bundle, and scored ~11:00-14:00 UTC. As a standalone probe it cannot be attributed (the effect is below noise), so it should not get its own slot.
